Thanks for the context, Aditya. Quick guidance below — I’ll need the final invoice number and confirmation of the exact stipend amount that was promised in the MOP (looks like $3,000 total stipend; usage shows $2,400 overage).

Accounting guidance (short):
- Preferred treatment: issue a credit memo to clear the customer invoice line (invoice-offset). Post against AR so the customer sees net-zero for the overage. This keeps revenue recognition clean and preserves the original invoice for audit.
- GL mapping: use GLA 4101 (Customer Credits - Pilot Allowances) as contra-revenue. If finance wants an alternative, we can post to 5205 (Sales & Marketing allowances) but only if the commercial team confirms promotional classification.
- Proforma vs final: generate a proforma credit memo for internal review and attach the signed MOP + usage CSV. Once approved, convert to final credit memo and apply to invoice.
- Approval: For credits < $5k, AP/AR manager approval is sufficient; send routing email to accounting@redwood.com and cc me.

Next steps for Aditya: send me the invoice number and confirm that the signed MOP indicates a pilot stipend of $3,000. I’ll prepare the proforma credit memo and route for approval. Also state whether we should classify as promotional allowance (impacting marketing metrics) or as contra-revenue (preferred).

Laura Bennett
Sr. Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: thermora-invoice-20260110.pdf, signed-mop-thermora.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Thermora pilot — invoice + request for stipend/top-up

Hi Jill — thanks for the note and for sending the docs. Per our internal review we’ll take the following path to close this out quickly:

1) We’ll issue a proforma credit memo today that maps the pilot stipend to the overage ($2,400). Laura will prepare and route it for < $5k approval.
2) Once approved, Accounting will convert to a final credit memo and apply it against your Jan 10 invoice so the outstanding balance is cleared. Expect confirmation that the invoice is net-zero within 48–72 hours post-approval.
3) We can extend the pilot window by one week at no additional charge. Tech/legal have signed off; please confirm the new end date you want and I’ll update the SOW amendment.

Next actions for Jill: confirm invoice number and the exact new end date for the pilot. I’ll loop back once the proforma is routed.

Appreciate the prompt handoff — cc’ing Laura & Karthik so finance/revops are in the loop.

Best,
